       MEET THE ORACLE

      A little guidance
      for your health questions.

      Baba Aramdev is a fictional health-information companion. You can ask any health-related question, from everyday habits to things you want to understand about your health.

      This version uses clearly labelled, prewritten demo fortunes. Gemini can power tailored replies once its server connection is configured.

      Questions aren’t saved by this app. With Gemini enabled, your question is sent to Google to generate your reply. Save a fortune only if you want it stored in this browser. Voice input uses your browser’s speech service.

      Baba can’t diagnose conditions, recommend medicines, or replace a clinician. If you feel seriously unwell or unsafe, seek urgent local help.

      Demo guidance: NHS sleep guidance ↗ · Gentle breathing ↗

       KIOSK CONTROLS

      Baba’s booth.

      Hold the button, speak, and release to send. You can also hold Space while the talk button is focused. Microphone access must be allowed. If voice capture isn’t available, use “Type instead”.

       BABA’S CONNECTION

      Check the oracle.

      Everyone can use Baba through this public link. The Gemini API key is kept on the server.

      If a test fails, its message will identify the API error. The site owner can use that message to fix the Worker’s key, model or quota.
